answer: Snapshot as of October 3, 2026. (1) September 30, 2026: Cal-Maine reported fiscal Q1 2027 (13 weeks ended August 29, 2026): net sales USD 539.6 million (-41.5% from USD 922.6 million), gross profit USD 0.4 million, operating loss USD 82.2 million and a net loss attributable of USD 58.6 million, or USD 1.26 per diluted share, versus net income of USD 199.3 million (USD 4.12) a year earlier [H20-E1][H20-E3]. Conventional shell egg net sales fell 59.5% on a 59.3% lower average selling price (segment loss USD 71.0 million); Specialty Shell Eggs and Prepared Foods rose to 54.1% of net sales [H20-E1]. (2) Under the variable dividend policy no dividend is payable for the quarter; USD 94.5 million of cumulative loss must be recovered before any future dividend [H20-E1]. (3) Buybacks: 66,601 shares for USD 5.0 million in the quarter (USD 315.7 million left of the USD 500 million program) and 204,888 shares for USD 14.9 million after quarter end [H20-E1]. (4) On August 31, 2026 (8-K filed September 2) the company entered into a Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement: a five-year senior unsecured revolver of up to USD 250 million (accordion up to another USD 250 million), maturing August 31, 2031, with nothing borrowed at September 1 [H20-E2]. Secondary coverage corroborates the loss and dividend decision [H20-E4].

output.answer:
## Cal-Maine Foods (Nasdaq: CALM) — Announcements in the 30 days to October 3, 2026

The dominant event in this window was the company's **fiscal 2027 first-quarter earnings release on September 30, 2026** (for the quarter ended August 29, 2026), with the 10-Q and related 8-K filings following and the earnings call on October 1.

### Quarterly results (announced Sept. 30, 2026)
| Metric | Q1 FY2027 | Q1 FY2026 | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| Net sales | $539.607M | $922.602M | −41.5% |
| Gross profit | $403K | $311.314M | −99.9% |
| Operating income (loss) | $(82.165)M | $249.184M | −133.0% |
| Net income (loss) attributable to CALM | $(58.615)M | $199.340M | −129.4% |
| Diluted EPS | $(1.26) | $4.12 | −130.6% |

- **Operating margin** −15.2% vs +27.0% prior year; effective tax rate 24.2%.
- **Segment detail:** Conventional Shell Eggs net sales $201.7M (down 59.5%, on a 59.3% ASP decline, volume roughly flat), segment operating loss $71.0M vs income of $168.2M. Specialty Shell Eggs $236.9M (down 14.0%), segment income $14.9M (6.3% margin) vs $64.2M. Prepared Foods $63.0M (down 13.0%), segment income $7.8M (12.4% margin) vs $13.2M.
- **Mix shift:** Specialty Shell Eggs + Prepared Foods rose to 54.1% of net sales vs 37.1% a year earlier (Prepared Foods alone 11.7% vs 7.8%).
- CEO Sherman Miller attributed the swing to an oversupplied egg market after fiscal 2026 layer-flock repopulation and lower conventional pricing.
- **Missed consensus** (EPS −$1.26 vs ~−$0.47 to −$0.76 expected; revenue $539.6M vs ~$587.8M expected). Shares fell ~3.5% premarket.

### Shareholder returns
- **Dividend suspended:** No cash dividend for Q1 FY2027 under the variable dividend policy. A dividend won't resume for any profitable quarter until the company is profitable on a **cumulative basis** from the last dividend-paying quarter — **$94.5 million** cumulative loss to be recovered as of August 29, 2026.
- **Buybacks:** Repurchased **66,601 shares for $5.0M** during Q1 FY2027 under the existing authorization. **Subsequent to quarter-end, repurchased an additional 204,888 shares for $14.9M** (as of Sept. 24, 2026).
- **Remaining authorization:** **$315.7M** available of the **$500M** program approved February 2025.

### Financing and capital
- **New credit agreement dated August 31, 2026** (disclosed in the Sept. 30 10-Q): a **senior unsecured revolving facility of up to $250 million, maturing August 31, 2031**. No amounts borrowed as of Sept. 30, 2026; $5.9M in outstanding standby letters of credit.
- **Liquidity:** Cash and short-term investments of **$767.6M** at Aug. 29, 2026, down from $924.1M at fiscal year-end (May 30, 2026); "virtually debt-free." Receivables $285.2M; inventories $394.7M; current liabilities $191.1M.
- **Cash flow/capex:** Net cash used in operations $(101.4)M vs +$278.6M a year earlier; **capex $26.6M**; **$25M** spent acquiring additional Eggland's Best franchise territory in the Northeast (effective July 10, 2026) for Maine, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, Rhode Island and select areas of Vermont, New York and Connecticut.
- **Capacity:** Projects expected to increase Prepared Foods production capacity **more than 60% by the first half of fiscal 2028** versus fiscal 2026 year-end (including a previously announced ~$54M investment adding ~30% incremental capacity).

**Sources:**
- Cal-Maine press release, Sept. 30, 2026: https://investors.calmainefoods.com/news-releases/news-release-details/cal-maine-foods-reports-first-quarter-fiscal-2027-results
- GlobeNewswire release: https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/09/30/3371667/0/en/cal-maine-foods-reports-first-quarter-fiscal-2027-results.html
- 8-K summary (StockTitan): https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/CALM/8-k-cal-maine-foods-inc-reports-material-event-b4835c83a140.html
- 10-Q summary (StockTitan): https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/CALM/10-q-cal-maine-foods-inc-quarterly-earnings-report-29973a853c98.html
- Q1 FY2027 earnings call transcript (Motley Fool): https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/10/01/cal-maine-foods-calm-q1-2027-earnings-call-transcript
- Quartz coverage: https://qz.com/cal-maine-foods-quarterly-loss-egg-prices-093026

A note on scope: the new $250M credit facility and the Eggland's Best acquisition were both executed slightly before or within the quarter rather than announced inside the Sept. 3–Oct. 3 window; they were **disclosed to the market within the window** via the Sept. 30 release/10-Q. I did not find any separate standalone announcements (e.g., a new dividend declaration or new financing deal) dated between Sept. 3 and Sept. 29, 2026.
